name: Bacon Wrapped Dates
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with a wire rack.
Stuff each date with a small amount of goat cheese.
Wrap each date with a half strip of bacon and secure with a toothpick.
Place on the rack and bake 18-20 minutes until bacon is crispy.
Let cool slightly before serving — the filling is very hot.
notes: The sweet-salty-savory combination makes these dangerously addictive.
